subject: info-ds
title: (R)INFO.DS.------SOC.RT.P.
description: Chart on book p. 164 (SR(TRS)II-20). INFO-DS (information dissemination) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; SOC-RT-P (social reality particular) is the partner. From the subject: CULT-INFO-F (culture information focus), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From CULT-INFO-F: AFL-DY (affinity dynamics). From AFL-DY: IST-ACT (isolated activism) and PR-TR. From PR-TR: DYM-F (dynamic functionalism). INFO-DOC (information documentation) is on a dotted line from PR-TR. From DYM-F: ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism).
